scope: Recover four native Niskara combat conversation requests for player-controlled pet/guardian/charmed-unit invokers without changing raw combat invokers or globally changing action206. Partial Marksmanship repair; no full chain or client visual certification.
root_cause: SmartAI EnterCombat/JustDied passes the actual enemy/killer. Existing target7 returns that Unit unchanged, while SUMMON_CONVERSATION206's non-coordinate branch accepts only Player targets. A pet/guardian/charmed creature therefore loses these conversation requests even though the already repaired action205/33 credit paths can resolve its owner. Replacing every combat invoker with its owner or choosing an unrelated nearest player would alter other native actions and is not the repair.
